description: Change the conditional operator in the STORED calculation of `toRead` from greater-than (>) to less-than (<), incorrectly calculating the number of bytes to read.
Change the array offset update for `offsetInBuffer` from addition (+) to subtraction (-) during STORED reading.
Change the bounds-checking comparison for buffer length/start from `<=` to `<` in the parameter validation guard.
Change the conditional check on `readBytesOfEntry >= csize` for STORED entries to use strictly-greater (`>`) instead of greater-than-or-equal (`>=`).
Change the assignment operator in `bytesReadFromStream += lengthOfLastRead` to subtraction assignment (`-=`), corrupting the tracking of bytes read from the stream.
